ideas.title: Investigation into Trump Administration's Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the motivations behind the Trump administration's freeze of $10 billion in child care funding and its effects on families and daycare providers.
questions: What were the motivations behind the freeze?
How has the freeze impacted families and daycare providers?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it has a significant impact on vulnerable populations and raises questions about the administration's priorities and handling of social services.

ideas.title: ICE Shooting Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of a woman by an ICE agent in Minnesota and the response by law enforcement.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
How did law enforcement respond to the incident?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it raises concerns about police brutality and accountability, and has sparked protests and calls for investigation.
